newsitem.title: MOROCCO: New flotation boosts slightly Morocco's bourse.
newsitem.headline: New flotation boosts slightly Morocco's bourse.

text.p: CASABLANCA, July 10 Reuter) - Casablanca stock exchange closed on Thursday 0.05 percent higher with main trade in newly-floated credit firm Maghrebail, brokers said.
The bourse all-share index closed at 638.56 points from 638.25 points on Tuesday.
The bourse was closed on Wednesday due to a public holiday.
"The inflated volume on the official market was the result of the flotation of shares worth 82 million dirhams of Maghrebail," a broker at ABN-AMRO Finance said.
Maghrebail said on Thursday, sale of 20 percent of the company has been oversubscribed 18 times.
Samir oil refinery was up six dirhams to 360 dirhams with more than 6,000 shares exchanged.
Wafabank closed unchanged at 810 dirhams with 3,398 shares traded.
First Moroccan private conglomerate, ONA Group closed unchanged at 775 dirhams with 1,998 shares traded.
Societe Nationale d'Investissement, the second largest private group, edged up two dirhams to 730.
First and second tranche of privatisation bonds, issued in January and May 1996, gained respectively 34 and 12 dirhams to 1,399 and 1,190 dirhams.
"Privatisation bonds should have decreased after the flotation of Imiter but they have been rising on rumours of an impending new flotation," the broker added.
Silver mine Societe Metallurgique d'Imiter fell 17 dirhams to 561 dirhams. It was floated early in June at an initial price of 396 dirhams.
Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur edged down two dirhams to 586 dirhams.
Total traded volume on the official market was 185.8 million dirhams from 21 million dirhams on Tuesday.
On the over-the-counter market, the volume was 33.9 from four million dirhams on the previous session. Main trade was in 12,400 ONA shares followed by 6,400 Wafabank shares.
